title: promptfrenzy.take-creator-link output
description: HTTP 201 (new link) or 200 (the same creator asking again) from POST /api/creators/claim. GET progress_url returns the same shape. Mirrors the live server contract, read from the live site on 27/11/2026.

handle.description: The handle as stored: lower case, no @.

link.description: The tracked link to share. ?via=<handle> can be added to any page on the site.

made_a_picture.description: People who signed up through the link and made a picture, counted once per device.

unlocks_at.description: The count at which the reward unlocks.

unlocked.description: True once the reward has been granted.

reward.description: The reward in words, for example "Pro free for 3 months".

terms.description: Version of the terms the link was taken under.

progress_url.description: GET this for the link's counts. Counts only, never who signed up.
